programme.title: I was the king – Grzegorz Lato | S01E02
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Grzegorz Lato won the top scorer's crown twice in the colors of Stal Mielec in the then 1st league, in 1973 and 1975. He was also the top scorer in the 1974 World Cup. After finishing his football career, he became a coach and later the president of the Polish Football Association (2008-2012). Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: I was a king – Kazimierz Kmiecik | S01E04
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Kazimierz Kmiecik is a legend of Wisła Kraków. He was associated with it both as a player and as a coach. To this day, he is the best scorer in the history of the White Star. He scored 153 goals in 304 matches played. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Wisła Cupiała | E03
programme.desc: The fate of Wisła Kraków during the reign of Bogusław Cupiał. It was a time of sporting successes, dramatic failures, an exciting fight for the Champions League and difficult relationships with fans. It is a look at a club that is a symbol of power and unfulfilled aspirations. In Bogusław Cupiał's club, each coach had to promise not only to win the national championship, but also to advance to the Champions League. The owner's lack of patience meant that most of the legendary Polish coaches passed through the team, leaving behind numerous memories. Poland. 2025. documentary series

programme.title: Franz | E05
programme.desc: The legendary coach Franciszek Smuda died on August 18, 2024. He is remembered by footballers, colleagues, friends and family, creating a portrait of a man who devoted his entire life to football. Viewers will be treated to a journey through the life of the popular Franz - from his childhood in Silesia, through the difficult beginnings of his football career, emigration, to his turbulent coaching career. He was successful as a coach of Widzew Łódź, Lech Poznań and Wisła Kraków. During Euro 2012 held in Poland and Ukraine, he led our team. Franciszek Smuda experienced three completely different periods in Krakow. He led the team to the Polish champion title, when the team was considered the national dream team. Then came the painful failure to fulfill European ambitions. After a decade, Smuda returned to Wawel, trying to restore the club's former glory. Poland. 2025. documentary series

programme.title: Najdziksza Ameryka Łacińska – Pantanal | E04
programme.desc: Latin America is one of the most diverse areas in the world. The largest tropical forests, vast swamps and the longest mountain chain are located here. Thanks to this series, viewers will see beautiful views and impressive rock formations in the Andes, lush Amazonian vegetation and Venezuelan wetlands. Each episode of the series is devoted to one region. It shows its natural environment, fauna and flora. In the heart of South America there is a vast, pristine space called the Pantanal plain. For part of the year, its area is flooded by a huge flood, with water levels exceeding five meters. In the following months, the area was hit by a great drought. Not only people have to cope with the vagaries of nature, animals also look for ways to survive. When the dry season comes, caimans gather where there is the most food, creating the largest concentration of these reptiles in the world. The Pantanal plain impresses with its rich fauna. They live here, among others: rare species of otters, jaguars and crocodiles. When heavy rains come and the area is covered with water, one of the largest waterfalls on Earth, Foz do Iguaco, comes to life in a breathtaking spectacle. Netherlands. 2012. documentary series

programme.title: Najdziksza Ameryka Łacińska – Andy | E05
programme.desc: Latin America is one of the most diverse areas in the world. The largest tropical forests, vast swamps and the longest mountain chain are located here. Thanks to this series, viewers will see beautiful views and impressive rock formations in the Andes, lush Amazonian vegetation and Venezuelan wetlands. Each episode of the series is devoted to one region. It shows its natural environment, fauna and flora. The Andes are the longest mountain range in the world, stretching along the entire western coast of South America. The Inca civilization had its cradle here, the traces of which are best seen in Machu Picchu. The Andes also attract mountaineers who treat climbing Aconcagua as training before conquering Mount Everest. The authors of the series look at how animals living here cope at high altitudes. Netherlands. 2012. documentary series

Great Britain. 2022. serial dokumentalny

programme.title: Secrets of water lands – Ice | S01E06
programme.desc: The authors invite viewers on underwater journeys through oceans, swamps and other water areas from various parts of the world. Under the influence of frost, water becomes an element of profound changes, especially in the coldest ecosystems on Earth. Filmmakers observe, among others: polar bears hunting seals, macaques bathing in natural hot springs and the unique survival strategy of arctic foxes. Great Britain. 2025. nature series

programme.title: In the Depths: North America – Changing Tides | S01E06
programme.desc: Filmowcy obserwują odległe zakątki kontynentu północnoamerykańskiego. W każdym odcinku wyruszają w inny rejon tego lądu. Obserwują z kamerą życie zwierząt z różnych miejscowych ekosystemów, od wód wybrzeży aż po sferę powietrzną. Podczas wyprawy na dalekiej i dzikiej Północy ekipa Lizzie oznakowuje rekiny. Obserwuje także z niepokojem proces powolnego zanikania lodu. Filmowcy odwiedzają specjalne więzienie dla niedźwiedzi polarnych, schwytanych podczas prób napadu na miasto w poszukiwaniu pożywienia. programme.title: Nile: the ultimate river – Life in the desert | E03
programme.desc: Researchers present extraordinary places located in the Nile Delta. They visit, among others: Lake Victoria and the Semien Mountains to look at the local fauna and flora. The Abyssinian Plateau is the cradle of the Blue Nile. Without its waters, the great river would evaporate in the desert before reaching the sea. The Blue Nile flows from Lake Tana in Ethiopia, where the Semien Mountains are located. With steep slopes in the warm rays of the sun and strong updrafts - it is a paradise for birds of prey. The slopes and peaks of the Semien Mountains are home to thousands of vultures. The upper parts of the Blue Nile are inhabited by rare species, such as geladas, close relatives of baboons, and Abyssinian ibexes. Austria. 2014. documentary film

programme.desc: «The least expected day: Ep.1» The old guard receives the recording of a new season of the series with many cautions. However, the new generation sees it as an opportunity. They are very different personalities, two very different worlds that share a team. Enric Mas, the veteran leader of the men's team, opens up more to the rest of his teammates. It is a renewed Enric, closer. He is preparing for the Tour with more ambition than ever. Iván Romeo is the visible head of a group of young runners who want to change things. He is ambitious, close, natural and with the soul of a leader. We know his most intimate side. He comes from a family passionate about cycling. As a child I traveled to France to watch the Tour go by from the sidelines. Now he is preparing for his first appearance in the race. His consecration comes in Dauphiné. With his stage victory, all the emotions come out. It has taken a while to get to where it is, but it is now a reality. In the Tour the first problems arrive for Enric

programme.title: The least expected day: Episode 1
programme.desc: «The least expected day: Ep.2» In the Tour, Enric does not go. What few know is that he suffers a major injury that weakens him more every day. In the middle of the chaos, Ivan Romeo appears. He dreams of his first stage in the Tour. On the women's team, Reusser has arrived to be the leader, but she has had problems for a long time. His crown in the Giro seems close, but the ghosts of the past return. She cries inconsolably after a great effort without reward. It is an example of improvement, but you will have to continue fighting. In addition, another figure stands out in the team, Liane Lippert. After the Tour, the men's team prepares for the race on which they have all their hopes: the Vuelta. However, Enric fails to recover in time. It's a suit for everyone. Iran without a leader. However, it is the perfect time to see the younger ones. That's when an unexpected figure appears. Aular flies and surprises directors and colleagues

programme.title: The least expected day: Episode 2
programme.desc: «The least expected day: Ep.3» The challenge is huge. The idea is to hunt stages. Enric supports the team from a distance, while the new generation in charge of leading the race fights with hunger. Reusser has overcome her problems and becomes CRI world and European champion. Face a new season with all its ghosts chased away. Meanwhile, in the men's Vuelta victory is very close, but something always fails at the last minute. It is an atypical and complicated return, but the team does not lose focus. Romo cherishes glory, but has to end up abandoning due to a fall. Communication problems appear between directors and brokers. To solve them, the figure of the psychologist is key. The year ends and the results are not as expected. A question appears in the air: when will the Movistar Team win again? The answer is optimism. The new generation is here to stay. to win

programme.title: The least expected day: Episode 3

programme.desc: «Football according to Raúl (1): Football without the ball» In times of confinement, Raúl, locked in his house, looks back to remember all those stories he has told throughout his professional career on the Movistar + screens. After reviewing photos, videos and memories, he decides to call a good part of those protagonists and friends that he has met along the way to find out about his new reality due to the coronavirus. A trip from Wuhan to Soria, passing through Chile or Japan in which Raúl, once the confinement is lifted, shows the most tragic face of the virus, discovers anonymous heroes and portrays the state of professional and amateur football in a time without football

programme.desc: «Matchday 9: Sevilla – Mallorca» Sevilla receives Mallorca with the aim of achieving its third consecutive victory in the League. The Balearic team is looking for its first points away from home this season. The Sevillistas have just won against Barcelona, ​​and have managed to secure thirteen of the last eighteen points at stake with just one defeat in their last six games played. Mallorca is bottom with five points, all of them achieved at home. They have lost in their four trips this season and their last away victory in the league dates back to last April in Anoeta against Real Sociedad. It comes from losing in San Mamés against Athlétic in its last league match

programme.title: 30 for 30: June 17, 1994
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

Volcanic Odysseys: The Gates of Hell (S1E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, JAV, 2015. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: Kanada, JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep3 «Volcanic Odysseys»…A Hawaiian volcano called Kilauea is one of the most active in the world. After years of constant lava activity, see how a sudden collapse of the crater floor and a massive eruption drains it of lava, making the volcano possible to explore | There are few forces on earth that equal the power and destructive force of a volcano. Their impact has helped shape this planet, altered climates, and laid waste to entire civilizations. That destructive power has terrified, awed and fascinated humans for centuries. However for those who understand them, they are beautiful spectacles of the earth's inner mechanism at work. Out of the approximately 550 active volcanoes on the planet, few are ever destructive. They remain content to put on a spectacle for all those near, or increasing numbers of adventurers who dare to venture to remote locations to watch one of natures most incredible shows. Where there is a demand, there is opportunity, A small German based company Volcano Discovery is cashing in on what has become a new craze, and catering to the adventurous and volcano curious Volcanologist Thomas Pfeiffer, and his team of local experts, take guests on exciting journeys around the world to the most eruptive volcanoes. From the notorious and deadly Krakatoa, to the remote and inhospitable heat of the Danakill Depression of Ethiopia, Volcanic Odysseys follows Thomas and his crew as they l take viewers into world of beauty and awe of this somewhat misunderstood spectacle | Director: Michael Dalton-Smith

programme.title: Arabian Seas: Island Feast (S1E3). Documentary about nature. England, 2017. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2017. S1, Ep3 «Arabian Seas»…Off the coast of Oman, summer weather drives nutrients in from the ocean depths where they meet the Arabian sun, causing an explosion of life. Smaller fish spawn, filling the waters with eggs. This creates a buffet predators just can't resist | Arabian Seas is a nature documentary series revealing the secrets of the mysterious Arabian waters, barely known to the rest of the world. This aquatic paradise is home to thousands of fascinating creatures, from endangered turtles, mysterious huge sharks and deadly rays to tiny shrimps and reef fish, zebra sharks and cuttlefish- camouflage kings. This marine heritage is splendid, but much of it is very vulnerable and in need of protection | Director: Harley Smith, Dan Chambers | Cast: Andrew Clark

programme.title: Arabian Seas: Defenders Of the Reef (S1E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2018. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2018. S1, Ep4 «Arabian Seas»…It's summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war | Arabian Seas is a nature documentary series revealing the secrets of the mysterious Arabian waters, barely known to the rest of the world. programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue: Baby Sea Otter Finds a Family (S1E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2020. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2020. S1, Ep1 «Wild Pacific Rescue»…Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Centre, where a harbour seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery | The wild, mountain ringed seas of British Columbia are home to fascinating and unique creatures. Marine veterinarian Martin Haulena and his loyal team help the animals in need in this region. The highly skilled group rescue and rehabilitate various sick or injured aquatic species. For them every animal counts, from small sea otter pups to giant sea lions | Director: Michael Sheehan | Cast: Tish Iceton

programme.title: A Wild Year on Earth: September-October – A Time of Activation (S1E5). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep5 «A Wild Year on Earth»…In southern Africa, the dry season is intensifying and stressed hippos crowd into smaller and smaller ponds, while in Australia the onset of spring sets young kangaroos on fire. In the rice fields of southwest China, the world's largest harvest is ready to be harvested. In the northern hemisphere, the September equinox marks the onset of fall. The caribou of northern Canada begin a migration to escape the approaching winter, avoiding hungry wolves. The tropical seas echo the songs of the humpback whale's mating season | Just as humans modify their behaviour to match their own calendar of rituals, animals coordinate their physiology and anticipate changes in the environment according to what their biological clocks dictate. Aiming to explain how various species handle the rhythmic natural patterns as they grow more extreme and turbulent every year, the story takes a closer look at the planet's most extraordinary seasonal events of migration, rebirth, and transformation | Director: Karina Holden

programme.title: A Wild Year on Earth: November-December – Full Circle (S1E6). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep6
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep6 «A Wild Year on Earth»…Witness some of the most incredible natural events in November, from the millions of Monarch butterflies that converge in Mexico's forests to the deep fog that shrouds the city of Dubai, signalling the start of winter | Charts the planet's most spectacular events of migration, rebirth and transformation. Over the course of a turbulent year, we witness how finely tuned creatures face the Earth's seasonal patterns. However, in the 21st Century, these patterns are becoming more extreme, less predictable and dangerously unreliable. Across the globe, we witness the drama and the spectacle. No matter what time of year it is, somewhere on Earth something miraculous is happening | Director: Karina Holden

programme.title: Africa's Hunters: Kings of Nsefu (S2E3). Documentary about nature. USA, 2018. S2, Ep3
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S2, Ep3 «Africa's Hunters»…Twin brothers with a powerful bond have ruled the Nsefu pride for three years. They're fathers to all the young, and protectors of their territory. Witness the struggle that unfolds when rival males target their territory | Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters | Director: Hannah Hoare

programme.title: Brazil Untamed: Bird Paradise (S1E2). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep2 «Brazil Untamed»…Witness the arrival of more than 650 bird species to the marshes and treetops of the Pantanal. Breeding season is accompanied by feasts for jabiru storks, cozy nest-making for hyacinth macaws, and mealtime squabbles for turkey vultures | The mesmerising wildlife of Brazil is revealed in this fascinating documentary series. Focussing on the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetlands, a team of scientists and camera crew study the remarkable creatures that inhabit the area. Predominantly located in the state of Mato Grosso do Sul, though also spreading into Mato Grosso, as well as Bolivia and Paraguay, this unique ecosystem is home to some of Brazil's most captivating species. The team work day and night to track these wonderful animals, including Capuchin monkeys, jaguars, giant otters, maned wolves, capybaras and a wealth of exotic birds | Director: Emmanuelle Wiecha

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Diaries (Barn Owl)
programme.desc: Naturalist and director Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano invites you on an exciting adventure through the Mediterranean! Together with him, you will be able to explore the unique ecosystems of this region, immerse yourself in the enchanting atmosphere of its culture and traditions, and discover the amazing diversity of flora and fauna. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Álex Campos Casares. Spain

programme.title: d/s Wildlife Diaries (Wolves)
programme.desc: Wolves are amazing creatures that are among the most skilled hunters in the wild. They live in packs, usually consisting of family groups, and each member of the pack plays a role. Dir.: Juan Antonio Rodriguez Llano, Álex Campos Casares. Spain

programme.title: d/s Birds: masters of the elements (Element of Air)
programme.desc: Birds live in the harshest corners of the planet - from the crater of a volcano to the depths of the sea. The series reveals the unique connection between birds and the four natural elements: air, water, earth and fire. They can withstand winds, overcome oceans, and get food in extreme conditions. But along with nature, they also have to adapt to human influence - the fifth element that they are encountering more and more often. Spain

programme.title: d/f Ibex: Alpine ibex
programme.desc: On the alpine peaks, an incredible story of rebirth plays out: the mountain goat, a symbol of endurance and grace, once again finds its place among the mountain peaks. These majestic animals were once in danger of extinction due to hunting and habitat loss. France

programme.title: d/s Wildlife of Singapore (River World)
programme.desc: Take an exciting journey through Singapore's rivers and waterways to learn about the rich flora and fauna that live there. Dir.: Bill Morris, John Ruthven. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/f Beaver – superhero of the wild
programme.desc: Beavers turn out to be much more important to nature than they might seem. Their dams, canals and wetlands form new ecosystems, maintain water levels and help the environment adapt to climate change. The film shows how the work of these rodents can help preserve biodiversity and protect nature. USA

programme.title: d/s Wild Italy: along with volcanoes. 3 s.
programme.desc: Most of the most beautiful Mediterranean islands are of volcanic origin

programme.title: d/f Queen of the North
programme.desc: Immerse yourself in the amazing world of the northern forests, where one of the most secretive and beautiful predators reigns. Observe her habits, hunting and struggle for survival in conditions of eternal winter. Discover how this graceful huntress became a symbol of endurance and strength, and why her presence is so important to the balance of the ecosystem. Mesmerizing footage and rare moments from the life of the northern lynx await you on this exciting journey. Spain

programme.title: film Wild Dogs. 2 s.
programme.desc: In Bucharest, where massive catches of stray dogs are taking place, the fates of several people intersect. Geordie, a pornographer from Canada, comes to Romania in search of subjects to work on, and an encounter with the locals forces him to reconsider his values. Bogdan, who works with homeless animals, is faced with a moral choice, and Natalie, the lonely wife of a diplomat, finds herself embroiled in the struggle for children, dogs and gypsies who find themselves on the margins of life. Canada

programme.title: d/f Monfrague National Park
programme.desc: Monfrague is Extremadura's first protected natural area and is home to more than two hundred unique species of animals. This place attracts with its ecological significance, as rare birds such as black vultures and imperial eagles live here. These species are critically endangered and conservation of this natural heritage plays a vital role in preserving the region's biodiversity. Spain

programme.title: d/f Wild World of Magellan
programme.desc: On board a replica of the Victoria ship, we set off on a journey to the remote corners of the planet, which Magellan and his crew explored 500 years ago. This journey will take us to unique and hidden natural paradises where we can observe the behavior of animals adapted to life in these remote places

programme.title: d/f Small but insidious
programme.desc: The world of predators is cruel, especially for the little ones. Their fast metabolism requires constant hunting, and they know no fear. Tiny hunters attack prey that is larger than them, and in the struggle for survival they do not even hesitate to hunt each other. Spain

programme.title: d/f Coral oasis of the Tuamotu island
programme.desc: Tuamotu are the “distant islands” of Tahiti, lost in the middle of the ocean, far from the noisy world and trade routes. This secluded archipelago is home to an amazingly rich environment: coral reefs, rare birds and marine animals that are still struggling to withstand the onslaught of the modern world. France

programme.title: d/f Kingdom of Mount Manaslu
programme.desc: Nepal's Manaslu region, the heart of the Himalayas, is a natural pearl between heaven and earth. Here man and nature have coexisted since time immemorial. People and animals have learned to adapt and survive in the most extreme conditions. These valleys - once secluded - are increasingly opening up to the outside world, and local communities are trying to control tourist flows and maintain their traditional way of life while adapting to modernity. France

programme.title: d/f Lion Queens: in the fight for survival
programme.desc: A drought strikes in the heart of the African savannah, and the lives of the lionesses change forever. Pursued by elephants and driven out by buffaloes, they lose access to water and their usual prey. Now every hunt is a risk, and every day is a struggle for survival and protection of your cubs. In these extreme conditions, the amazing strength, cohesion and courage of lionesses are revealed. Their story is a tale of motherhood, leadership and the tireless struggle to preserve the pride, where not only their own lives are at stake, but also the future of the entire family

programme.title: d/f Another Nepal: Shuklaphanta Nature Reserve

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Special cameras in the lion enclosure at Longleat Safari Park are intended to reveal what happens there after dark. Wolf Dave tries time and time again to break out of his area. (Station info).

programme.title: Crazy but true!

programme.title: LOST U-BOATS OF WWII EP02
programme.desc: Cuộc tìm kiếm những chiếc U-Boat của Đức Quốc xã bị mất chứa đầy kho báu của thợ săn kho báu Darrell Miklos có bước ngoặt bất ngờ khi một nhân chứng địa phương 98 tuổi cho ông một lời khuyên giúp thay đổi quá trình điều tra của ông.

programme.title: THE BERMUDA TRIANGLE: INTO CURSED WATERS S2 EP05
programme.desc: Những manh mối mới có chỉ ra bí ẩn lớn nhất về Tam giác quỷ Bermuda không? Mike Barnette, Jimmy Gadomski và nhóm điều tra lần nữa lần theo dấu vết của một vụ án bí ẩn khiến họ mất ngủ hàng đêm.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S14 EP05
programme.desc: Anna nhắm vào quái vật đầm lầy bằng cung tên của mình. Pickle gây bất ngờ cho Troy bằng vũ khí bí mật của cô. Cậu bé Willie báo tin cho bố làm thay đổi mùa giải của họ.

programme.title: HOW DISNEY BUILT AMERICA EP03
programme.desc: Walt Disney đã vượt qua những trở ngại to lớn để tạo ra công viên giải trí đầu tiên, nơi thay vì những trò chơi cảm giác mạnh, ông mang đến cho du khách một hành trình đắm chìm vào một câu chuyện, giống như trải nghiệm như đang ở trong một bộ phim.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP08
programme.desc: Trong Chiến dịch Ngọn đuốc, cuộc tấn công chung đầu tiên giữa Mỹ và Anh trong cuộc chiến, hàng nghìn lính Mỹ thiếu kinh nghiệm đã đối đầu với Quân đoàn châu Phi cứng rắn của Đức và Thống chế khét tiếng Erwin Rommel.

programme.title: THE BERMUDA TRIANGLE: INTO CURSED WATERS S2 EP05
programme.desc: Những manh mối mới có chỉ ra bí ẩn lớn nhất về Tam giác quỷ Bermuda không? Mike Barnette, Jimmy Gadomski và nhóm điều tra lần nữa lần theo dấu vết của một vụ án bí ẩn khiến họ mất ngủ hàng đêm.

programme.title: HAZARDOUS HISTORY WITH HENRY WINKLER S1 EP06
programme.desc: Từ những chiếc ô tô phát nổ và thảm họa khinh khí cầu cho đến những đứa trẻ được gửi qua đường bưu điện và những chiếc trực thăng cá nhân bị hủy diệt, quá khứ chứa đầy những câu chuyện du lịch đáng kinh ngạc đã mở đường cho giao thông vận tải hiện đại.

programme.title: WORLD WAR II WITH TOM HANKS EP07
programme.desc: Khi tầm ảnh hưởng của Hitler vượt ra ngoài nước Đức và bóng tối bao trùm châu Âu, lối hùng biện đầy hận thù của hắn dẫn đến cuộc đàn áp chống người Do Thái và cuối cùng là nạn diệt chủng.

programme.title: HIDDEN CITIES S2 EP01
programme.desc: Từ những cuộc chiến tranh bị lãng quên từ lâu đã tàn phá một đế chế Hindu cho đến sự khéo léo của người dân, hãy tìm hiểu về lịch sử bạo lực và sự kiên cường của người Việt Nam.

programme.title: THE UNXPLAINED WITH WILLIAM SHATNER S3 EP16
programme.desc: Ngày nay, nền văn minh của loài người trải rộng trên toàn cầu và có hơn 7 tỷ người trên Trái đất. Nhưng loài người đã tiến hóa như thế nào? Có những loại sinh vật giống con người khác không?

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S15 EP10
programme.desc: Khi mùa cá sấu bước vào những tuần cuối cùng, Ronnie thách thức danh hiệu 'Vua đầm lầy' của Troy. Cuộc chiến của Landry với kẻ săn trộm. Động cơ thuyền của Bruce bị hỏng do căng thẳng của mùa giải dài.

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S1 EP05
programme.desc: Bạn có bao giờ tự hỏi sẽ như thế nào khi bị tấn công bởi hàng triệu con dơi với những quả bom nhỏ xíu buộc trên ngực chúng không? Thế còn xe tăng bơm hơi, robot sát thủ, bazooka Vespa, cá heo chiến tranh...

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP17
programme.desc: Tinh thần lên cao và Hội đồng hành trở nên tràn đầy hy vọng hơn bao giờ hết khi cả nhóm đào sâu vào hang động của Aladdin.

programme.title: SECRETS DECLASSIFIED WITH DAVID DUCHOVNY S1 EP08
programme.desc: Họ nói tốt hơn là quỷ dữ, bạn biết đấy, nhưng điều gì sẽ xảy ra khi bạn phải nắm tay hắn? Khi các chính phủ tiến hành giải quyết các giáo phái, đám đông và thậm chí cả kẻ thù, các mối quan hệ băng giá sẽ bị thử thách trực diện.

programme.title: MOUNTAIN MEN S13 EP05
programme.desc: Marty chiến đấu với mùa đông tàn khốc ở Alaska trong khi điều hành đường dây bẫy bị cháy rừng tàn phá ở Viễn Bắc; Mike lấy lại một bộ tấm pin mặt trời bị bỏ hoang để cung cấp năng lượng cho ngôi nhà trên đảo Kodiak của anh.

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S15 EP10
programme.desc: Khi mùa cá sấu bước vào những tuần cuối cùng, Ronnie thách thức danh hiệu 'Vua đầm lầy' của Troy. Cuộc chiến của Landry với kẻ săn trộm. Động cơ thuyền của Bruce bị hỏng do căng thẳng của mùa giải dài.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: THIẾU NIÊN DIỆP VẤN: THỜI KHẮC NGUY HIỂM - YOUNG IP MAN: CRISIS TIME
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 1917, chàng trai trẻ Diệp Vấn theo đuổi việc học ở Hồng Kông. Ngôi trường bị bắt làm con tin vào ngày diễn ra cuộc thi hùng biện tiếng Anh, và khi Diệp Vấn quyết định đứng lên chống lại cuộc khủng hoảng, người ta tiết lộ rằng chủ nhân và người bạn thời thơ ấu của anh đứng đằng sau tất cả những điều này. Liệu anh ta có thể hạ gục họ và bảo vệ công lý?

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: BẠCH PHÁT MA NỮ - BRIDE WITH THE WHITE HAIR
programme.desc: Đệ tử Thiên Sơn Yu Luo Sha thách thức bốn giáo phái lớn và giết chết các thủ lĩnh của họ, làm rung chuyển thế giới võ thuật. Trác Nhất Hàng đối mặt với cô nhưng lại yêu. Khi anh chuẩn bị kết hôn với người khác, cô tóc bạc trắng và thề sẽ không bao giờ gặp lại.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.

programme.title: NHIỆM VỤ NGUY HIỂM - MUNITIONS HIJACKING CASE
programme.desc: Đặc vụ Wen được giao nhiệm vụ bí mật cho một đại lý vũ khí ở Đông Nam Á để xác định vị trí và phá hủy kho đạn dược. Tuy nhiên, cuối cùng khi tìm thấy chúng, anh bị tấn công bởi những tên xã hội đen vô danh và phải hợp tác với đồng đội của mình để thu hồi vũ khí và ngăn chặn thảm họa.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: THIẾU NIÊN DIỆP VẤN: THỜI KHẮC NGUY HIỂM - YOUNG IP MAN: CRISIS TIME
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 1917, chàng trai trẻ Diệp Vấn theo đuổi việc học ở Hồng Kông. Ngôi trường bị bắt làm con tin vào ngày diễn ra cuộc thi hùng biện tiếng Anh, và khi Diệp Vấn quyết định đứng lên chống lại cuộc khủng hoảng, người ta tiết lộ rằng chủ nhân và người bạn thời thơ ấu của anh đứng đằng sau tất cả những điều này. Liệu anh ta có thể hạ gục họ và bảo vệ công lý?

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: BẠCH PHÁT MA NỮ - BRIDE WITH THE WHITE HAIR
programme.desc: Đệ tử Thiên Sơn Yu Luo Sha thách thức bốn giáo phái lớn và giết chết các thủ lĩnh của họ, làm rung chuyển thế giới võ thuật. Trác Nhất Hàng đối mặt với cô nhưng lại yêu. Khi anh chuẩn bị kết hôn với người khác, cô tóc bạc trắng và thề sẽ không bao giờ gặp lại.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.

programme.title: TRỪ BẠO AN LƯƠNG - PUNISH EVIL
programme.desc: Một lô hàng tiền mới phát hành bị ba tên cướp có vũ trang cướp, khiến thám tử Chang phải điều tra. Lần theo những manh mối mới, anh đã hạ gục thành công một trong những tên cướp. Trong khi đó, hai người còn lại âm mưu cướp một xưởng vàng giữa lúc hỗn loạn. Với kế hoạch tỉ mỉ, Chang đã phá vỡ âm mưu của họ và đưa họ ra trước công lý.
